Definition: from G3361 and G4452; not yet:--not yet.
BiblicalUsage: Mepo means not yet, and it marks the things God has promised but not yet shown. Hebrews 9:8 says the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest while the first tabernacle was yet standing, and Romans 9:11 says the twins were not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, when God's purpose in election stood.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe 'not yet' is God's patience in two words: the way was coming, and the choice was already made.
